builder_plan.scenario: Start with one repeated product task that has a measurable failure or cost.
builder_plan.change: Read the methods and identify one change you can isolate in that workflow.
builder_plan.baseline: Your current implementation on the same held-out tasks.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Successful outcomes, response time, human rework, and total cost per successful task.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: ReCIM-HD: A 40 nm On-Device Learning Accelerator with Hyperdimensional Computing via Importance-Based Hybrid Digital-ReRAM CIM
summary: ReCIM-HD replaces backpropagation-based on-device learning with gradient-free hyperdimensional computing executed on a custom 40 nm ReRAM compute-in-memory accelerator, using analog similarity search for class hypervectors and a small digitally protected subset to preserve accuracy. Its cost is custom silicon with a custom ISA and encoder, plus the accuracy limitations inherent to HDC classifiers, which are well below deep networks on complex modalities such as images and natural language. Analog ReRAM computation also risks device variability, conductance drift, and noise degrading inference accuracy outside the hybrid digital fallback path.
rationale: The technique is a fabricated ReRAM compute-in-memory chip for hyperdimensional computing, which a software practitioner with a single GPU or API access cannot acquire, program, or replicate.
technique: ReRAM CIM accelerator for hyperdimensional on-device learning

claims.statement: ReCIM-HD replaces backpropagation-based on-device learning with gradient-free hyperdimensional computing executed on a custom 40 nm ReRAM compute-in-memory accelerator, using analog similarity search for class hypervectors and a small digitally protected subset to preserve accuracy. Its cost is custom silicon with a custom ISA and encoder, plus the accuracy limitations inherent to HDC classifiers, which are well below deep networks on complex modalities such as images and natural language. Analog ReRAM computation also risks device variability, conductance drift, and noise degrading inference accuracy outside the hybrid digital fallback path.

44.17 TOPS/W (hybrid mode) and 75.8 TOPS/W (ReRAM CIM mode); up to 20.1x higher energy efficiency than the state-of-the-art accelerator, but these are silicon measurements on fabricated 40 nm hardware, not software-achievable gains.
